title: Make sure the death has been pronounced
plain_summary: Before anything else, a doctor, hospice nurse, or other authorized person officially pronounces the death. If hospice was caring for them, the hospice team usually handles this.
why_now: The funeral home and the death certificate both wait on this step.

citations.authority_name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics, Medical Examiners' and Coroners' Handbook on Death Registration
